color.note: Light only: every Sentri screen declares color-scheme light. Names match the CSS custom properties the prototypes already use, so tokens.css drops straight in.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The studio/desk background behind the phone canvas. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: app-background
tokens.usage: The app canvas: status bar, task header, full-page sheets. Pages put white `paper` panels on it.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Panels on a page, drawer bodies, footers, secondary buttons, text fields.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet raised area on the canvas (sync card, summary blocks).

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Panels inside a drawer (the drawer itself is `paper`), notes fields, short chooser insets.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, tool buttons, unit-number chips. Also exported as `--wash`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, and the fill of every primary button (white label). 14.6:1 on `paper`, 13.4:1 on `app-background`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, fact labels, group headings, chevrons. 5.2:1 on `paper`, 4.8:1 on `app-background`, 4.6:1 on `well` — do not set it on anything darker.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders, header and footer dividers, icon-button borders. Decorative (1.3:1): it separates surfaces that already differ, never marks a control on its own.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline between rows inside a panel. Rules appear only between rows, never above the first.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Text fields, picker triggers and secondary buttons. Source value; 1.8:1 on `paper`, below the 3:1 control-border floor — the label and the 44px+ geometry carry the control today.

tokens.name: back-border
tokens.usage: The Back button in sheet footers and the paired secondary in drawer footers.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done / recorded / synced, the selected check in pickers, the wordmark dot. 6.9:1 on `paper`. Never a button fill: primary actions are `ink`. Status map: `done` (and a resolved condition) are green; nothing else is.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Current-location row background, pressed task in the context card, synced summary.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Due now / waiting to upload. Text and icons only (5.6:1 on `paper`). Never decorative. Status map: `late`, and a condition that needs attention (Monitor, Treat in place).

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a pending/attention block that carries `amber` text.

tokens.name: pending-surface
tokens.usage: Sync card and sync summary while records wait to upload; border `pending-border`.

tokens.name: pending-border
tokens.usage: Border of `pending-surface` blocks. Also the border of an amber status chip or condition tag.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive and ending actions only (Delete photo, End task): filled with white label, 6.6:1. Also field error borders. Status map: `overdue`, `sow died` and a hospital-pen condition are red text on `red-wash`.

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: The "End early" button: `red-wash` fill, `red` border and label.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Status map: `active` (in progress), on `progress-wash`. 5.8:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: progress-wash
tokens.usage: The fill of the Status chip for `active` (`progress` text on it, 5.2:1).

tokens.name: chip-progress-border
tokens.usage: The border of the `active` Status chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px (rows: offset -3px). 4.2:1 on `paper`, 3.9:1 on `app-background`.

tokens.name: current-marker
tokens.usage: The 3px inset bar on the current-location row and the underline of the active category tab.

tokens.name: tab-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive category-footer tab labels. 4.9:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: tab-ink-active
tokens.usage: Active category-footer tab label (700 weight).

tokens.name: row-icon-bg
tokens.usage: The 34px rounded tile behind a row's leading icon.

tokens.name: row-icon-ink
tokens.usage: Stroke colour of a row's leading icon.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a row or picker option.

tokens.name: choice-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a chooser row.

tokens.name: log-line
tokens.usage: The vertical thread of an activity log.

tokens.name: log-dot
tokens.usage: The 7px node on each log entry.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: The 92×4px home-indicator bar at the foot of pages and footers.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button fill and border.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Disabled button label. Exempt from contrast by definition — never use for live text.

tokens.name: count-surface
tokens.usage: The hero count area in the piglet count sheet.

tokens.name: count-ink
tokens.usage: The hero count figure on `count-surface`.

tokens.name: count-key
tokens.usage: The filled +1 key of the hero stepper (white glyph).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The rulings' ink2: the text-action register (a bare word, no container). 8.3:1 on `paper`, 7.7:1 on `app-background`, 7.3:1 on `well`.

tokens.name: amber-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The correction banner's wash, strong enough to read as amber in sunlight; `amber` text holds 4.6:1 on it and its border is `amber`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a drawer, with a 1.4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dialog-backdrop
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a centred or bottom dialog.

tokens.name: frame-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The phone frame's 1px edge when a task page renders inside the 390×844 frame on a wider screen (TaskPhone). Device chrome, never inside the app.

tokens.name: chip-green-border
tokens.usage: The border of a green chip: Status `done` and a resolved ConditionTag. The chip is `green` on `green-wash`.

tokens.name: chip-red-border
tokens.usage: The border of a red chip: Status `overdue` and `sow died`, and a hospital-pen ConditionTag. The chip is `red` on `red-wash`.

tokens.name: progress-active
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The middle segment of the summary card's task progress bar (TaskSummary): started, not finished. Done is `current-marker`, not started is `handle`, the track is `line`.

tokens.name: task-key-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 2, ADR 0003, owner round 5: match farrowing) — not approved. The 1px outline of farrowing's stepper keys and camera key (`--key`), in a task's Stepper and Photos face (TaskStepper, TaskPhotos) and the choice tiles (TaskChoice).

tokens.name: banner-wash
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 4, ADR 0003, owner round 5: match farrowing) — not approved. The fill of farrowing's End banner (TaskWarning tone amber: `9 sows will be removed from this batch`).

tokens.name: banner-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 4, ADR 0003) — not approved. The 1px edge of farrowing's End banner (TaskWarning tone amber).

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 3, ADR 0003, owner round 5: match farrowing) — not approved. The 1px edge of farrowing's danger band on `red-wash` (TaskWarning).

tokens.name: choice-pressed-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 2, ADR 0003, owner round 5: match farrowing) — not approved. The outline of the chosen choice tile on `green-wash` (TaskChoice: Foster piglets, Send / Receive).

tokens.name: back-press
tokens.usage: Back button pressed fill.

tokens.name: button-border
tokens.usage: Default (secondary) button rim.

tokens.name: disabled-border
tokens.usage: Disabled button rim.

tokens.usage: Disabled button fill in the base layer.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Text field rim in the base layer.

tokens.name: focus-strong
tokens.usage: Base-layer keyboard focus ring (button, link, field) where the page has no `focus` ring.

styles.name: entry-label

styles.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The lead identifier of a list row (Row `code`): a crate code the eye runs down.

styles.name: figure-denominator
styles.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The `/ n` after the task-overview count on the summary card, `muted`.

styles.name: figure-total

styles.name: table-heading

styles.name: dock-caption
styles.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 4, ADR 0003, owner round 5: match farrowing) — not approved. The caption under the dock's place control (TaskDock unit: `B1 / Go to pen`). Below the 10px floor by the owner's ruling, like `hold-caption`; only here. Sans.

styles.name: metric

styles.name: metric-total
styles.usage: Candidate (task skeleton 3, ADR 0003) — not approved. A performance card's small totals (TaskMetrics), mono.

styles.name: figure-well
